episode_title: Trump Trilateral Summit In China, House Democratic Leadership, Anthropic IPO
script_en: Trump Trilateral Summit In China, House Democratic Leadership, Anthropic IPO.
President Trump met with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin together for the first time, but the meeting produced no major breakthrough as tensions remain over Ukraine, technology and Taiwan.

House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries to become the next Speaker and are already laying the groundwork for investigations into President Trump’s inner circle as they prepare to take control of the chamber.
Anthropic begins trading publicly after the biggest IPO in history, testing how much appetite investors still have for artificial intelligence amid growing concerns about an AI bubble.
